requirements.name: python-fastapi-sqlite-stack
requirements.text: Implement in Python 3.11 or newer with FastAPI, served by uvicorn, over SQLite.

requirements.name: fxrates-executable
requirements.text: The product is an executable named `fxrates` at the application root.

requirements.name: test-suite-and-launcher
requirements.text:
The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs its own pytest suite
from the application root and exits zero only when every test passes.

requirements.name: test-coverage
requirements.text:
The suite covers each command, each load rule, each endpoint, the effective-date rule, rounding, and each error status,
against a real temporary database, with `fetch` stubbed.

requirements.name: rates-schema
requirements.text: | `rates` | `date` text `YYYY-MM-DD`, `currency` text, `rate` text | unique (`date`, `currency`) |

requirements.name: rate-storage-and-arithmetic
requirements.text:
A rate is stored exactly as the ECB publishes it, as text. `0.943` stays `0.943`, never `0.9430
` and never a float. Arithmetic on rates uses Python's `decimal` module.

requirements.name: database-location
requirements.text:
`DATABASE_URL` names the SQLite database file, optionally prefixed `sqlite://`. When it is unset,
`DATABASE_PATH` is used, then `data/app.db`.

requirements.name: shared-persistence-access
requirements.text:
All database access goes through the shipped persistence library and the relational layer generated
from `DATABASE.md`. Application code never opens a database driver directly.

requirements.name: initialize-empty-store
requirements.text: `fxrates init` | Drops the `rates` table if present and creates it empty. | Nothing.

requirements.name: load-ecb-history
requirements.text: `fxrates load <csv>` | Loads an ECB history file (rules below). | `dates,rates`, then the number of dates and of rates stored from the file.

requirements.name: fetch-ecb-history
requirements.text: `fxrates fetch` | Downloads `https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-hist.zip`, extracts `eurofxref-hist.csv`, and loads it as `load` does. | As `load`.

requirements.name: serve-http-api
requirements.text: `fxrates serve [--port <n>]` | Serves the HTTP API on `127.0.0.1:<n>` with uvicorn until stopped. Default port `8000`. | Nothing required.

requirements.name: parse-ecb-csv-header
requirements.text:
The file is CSV. The header's first field is `Date`, and every other field is a three-letter
uppercase currency code. The ECB writes a trailing comma on every line, and the resulting
empty last field is ignored.

requirements.name: validate-ecb-csv-rows
requirements.text:
Each row is a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, a real calendar date, not repeated within the file) followed
by one value per currency. The value `N/A` means no rate, and nothing is stored for it. Any
other value must match `[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?` and be nonzero.

requirements.name: reject-invalid-file-atomically
requirements.text:
**A rejected file changes nothing.** The whole file is checked before the first write. A row
with the wrong field count, an invalid or repeated date, or an invalid value rejects the file.

requirements.name: replace-existing-rates
requirements.text:
A rate for a (`date`, `currency`) that is already stored replaces it, so loading the same file
twice leaves the database unchanged.

requirements.name: report-load-counts
requirements.text:
The reported `dates` counts the dates with at least one stored rate, and `rates` counts the
rates stored.

requirements.name: report-cli-errors
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: stub-fetch-download
requirements.text:
`fetch` is never run by the harness. Its tests replace the download with a stub and never use
the network.

requirements.name: cli-exit-codes
requirements.text:
**Exit codes.** `0` success. `1` operational failure: the file cannot be read, or a `fetch`
download fails. `2` usage error: unknown command, wrong argument count, `--port` not an integer.
`3` rejected file.

requirements.name: json-http-responses
requirements.text:
Every response is JSON. EUR is the base. A rate is the number of units of a currency per euro, and
EUR itself has the implicit rate `1`.

requirements.name: effective-publication-date
requirements.text:
**Effective date.** The ECB publishes on working days only. A request for date `D` uses the latest
publication date on or before `D`. If none exists, the response is `404`.

requirements.name: health-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /health` | `{"status": "ok"}` |

requirements.name: stats-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /stats` | `{"dates": <n>, "rates": <n>, "first": <date>, "last": <date>}`. `first` and `last` are `null` when the table is empty. |

requirements.name: currencies-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /currencies` | `{"base": "EUR", "currencies": [<code>, ...]}`: every currency with at least one stored rate, ascending. |

requirements.name: rates-by-date-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /rates/{date}` | `{"date": <effective date>, "requested": <date>, "base": "EUR", "rates": {<code>: <rate>, ...}}`: every currency with a rate on the effective date. |

requirements.name: latest-rates-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /rates/latest` | As `/rates/{date}` for the latest publication date, with `"requested": "latest"`.

requirements.name: convert-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /convert?from=<code>&to=<code>&amount=<amount>[&date=<date>]` | `{"date": <effective date>, "from": <code>, "to": <code>, "amount": <amount>, "rate": <rate>, "result": <result>}`. Without `date`, the latest publication date is used. |

requirements.name: history-endpoint
requirements.text: | `GET /history/{code}[?start=<date>][&end=<date>]` | `{"currency": <code>, "base": "EUR", "count": <n>, "min": <rate>, "max": <rate>, "mean": <mean>, "points": [{"date": <date>, "rate": <rate>}, ...]}` for the publication dates from `start` through `end` inclusive, ascending. Both bounds are optional. With no points, `count` is `0`, `min`, `max`, and `mean` are `null`, and `points` is `[]`. |

requirements.name: rate-response-values
requirements.text: - `<rate>` in `/rates`, `min`, `max`, and `points` is the stored text, as a JSON string.

requirements.name: convert-amount-validation-and-echo
requirements.text: - `/convert` `amount` matches `[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?` and is echoed as given, as a JSON string.

requirements.name: convert-rate-rounding
requirements.text:
- `/convert` `rate` is `rate(to) / rate(from)`, computed exactly and rounded half to even to six
  decimal places, written with exactly six decimals, as a JSON string: `"161.770000"`.

requirements.name: convert-result-rounding
requirements.text:
- `/convert` `result` is `amount × rate(to) / rate(from)`, computed exactly from the stored rates
  (not from the rounded `rate`) and rounded half to even to two decimal places, written with exactly two decimals, as a JSON string: `"82.01"`.

requirements.name: history-summary-values
requirements.text:
- `/history` `min` and `max` are the stored text of the smallest and largest rate by value.
  `mean` is the exact mean rounded half to even to six decimal places, written with exactly six
  decimals, as a JSON string.

requirements.name: not-found-api-errors
requirements.text: | `404` | No publication on or before the requested date; a `/convert` currency other than EUR with no rate on the effective date; a `/history` currency with no stored rate at all (including `EUR`). |

requirements.name: validation-api-errors
requirements.text: | `422` | A malformed date in the path or query, a malformed `amount`, or a missing required query parameter. FastAPI's request validation produces this status. |

requirements.name: live-load-visibility
requirements.text: A load that completes while the server is running is visible to the next request.

requirements.name: supplied-grader-conformance
requirements.text:
`sources/run.sh` is the scoring entry point. It is supplied, not authored, and is staged verbatim
into the application root with the data files. `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/run.sh` from the
completed application root and takes its exit code and output as the score.

requirements.name: grader-http-and-command-checks
requirements.text:
The harness sets `DATABASE_URL` to a fresh temporary SQLite file, runs `./fxrates init` and
`./fxrates load`, starts `./fxrates serve --port <port>` in the background on a free local port,
waits up to 30 seconds for `GET /health`, and then runs HTTP requests against `127.0.0.1`. It
makes 35 checks. A command check compares exit code and standard output. An HTTP check compares
the status code and, for status 200, the JSON body as a value (key order and whitespace do not
matter). Standard error and error-response bodies are never compared. The harness never runs
`fetch` and uses no network beyond `127.0.0.1`. It prints `PASS` or `FAIL` per check and ends with:

```text
FxRates: NN passed, NN failed (of 35)
```

requirements.name: read-only-scoring-assets
requirements.text:
- `sources/run.sh` — the scoring entry point and its known answers
- `sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv` — the ECB history for January 2025: 22 publication dates,
  8 currencies, and an `HRK` column that is `N/A` on every date
- `sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv` — two further dates, 2025-02-03 and 2025-02-04
- `sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv` — a valid first row and an invalid rate on its second row

requirements.name: health-scoring-and-application-isolation
requirements.text:
Application code never reads `sources/run.sh` and never embeds an answer. Every value comes from
the database.

requirements.name: validate-and-load-history
requirements.text: Validate and load ECB CSV history files atomically.

requirements.name: executable-deliverable
requirements.text: The deliverable is an executable named fxrates at the application root.

requirements.name: initialize-store
requirements.text: check A1 0 init < /dev/null

requirements.name: load-ecb-history
requirements.text:
check A2 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176
EOF

requirements.name: repeated-load-is-safe
requirements.text:
check A3 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176

requirements.name: reject-invalid-csv
requirements.text: check A4 3 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv" < /dev/null

requirements.name: report-missing-file-error
requirements.text: check A5 1 load "$WORK/no-such-file.csv" < /dev/null

requirements.name: report-cli-usage-errors
requirements.text:
check U1 2 < /dev/null
check U2 2 frobnicate < /dev/null
check U3 2 load < /dev/null
check U4 2 serve --port notaport < /dev/null

requirements.name: serve-health-endpoint
requirements.text: start_server

requirements.name: health-response
list-stored-currencies
report-rates-date-errors
requirements.text:
http H6 404 '/rates/2024-12-31' < /dev/null
http H7 422 '/rates/2025-13-01' < /dev/null

requirements.name: convert-currency-amounts
report-conversion-errors
requirements.text:
http H13 404 '/convert?from=USD&to=XXX&amount=1' < /dev/null
http H14 422 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP' < /dev/null
http H15 422 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=abc' < /dev/null
http H16 404 '/convert?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=10&date=2024-12-01' < /dev/null

requirements.name: load-while-serving
requirements.text:
check L1 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
2,16
